dataformat.name: zipDeflater
dataformat.title: Zip Deflater
dataformat.description: Compress and decompress streams using java.util.zip.Deflater and java.util.zip.Inflater
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: The data to compress: text in the charset of the exchange, bytes, a stream or a file

marshalOut.description: The deflate data in the zlib format, not a zip file, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: Deflate data in the zlib format, such as marshal gives with any compressionLevel

unmarshalOut.description: The decompressed data in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

compressionLevel.description: Compression level to use (0-9). -1 is default compression, 0 is no compression, and 9 is the best compression.
